project.name: skilient
project.description: University-gated platform where Pakistani students prove skills through project work and turn it into a signed, verifiable CV for recruiters, faculty and universities.

nodes.name: Identity and Onboarding
nodes.summary: University-gated signup, sign-in with two-factor, agreements and the onboarding steps that bring a student to a working profile. Signup is limited to live universities by email domain.

businessRules: Signup requires a live university email domain
No account lockout; Turnstile after failed passwords
Gate decision table keeps users on the right page
crossDomainInteractions: Recruiters, faculty and officials sign up through the same hook

nodes.name: Skill Proof and Ventures
nodes.summary: Students connect GitHub, import commits and pull requests, and earn skill levels L1 to L4 from evidence. Ventures, contributions, endorsements, credentials and code checks add peer and staff verification.

businessRules: Skill levels come from evidence, never client claims
A venture completes only with peer-verified contributions from at least two members
Endorsement limits are enforced in SQL
Code checks store only where a snippet lives
crossDomainInteractions: Credentials and code checks are reviewed in Ops

nodes.name: Social Network and Chat
nodes.summary: Friends, blocks, posts, comments, polls, the ranked feed, chat and Explore search. There are no likes or reactions on posts and no video.

businessRules: Blocks are honoured by every read
Notifications are written only by triggers
Emails capped at 60 a day
crossDomainInteractions: Venture group chats follow venture membership

nodes.name: Ranking and Leaderboard
nodes.summary: A nightly state machine scores each student from work, skills, endorsements, credentials and momentum using a versioned formula, with anti-gaming flags and published tiers.

businessRules: Formula lives in platform_config and its version is the formula version
Rank is never sold
Students can opt out of the leaderboard
crossDomainInteractions: Badges awarded by universities are never read by ranking

nodes.name: Verified CV
nodes.summary: A signed, verifiable CV built from a SQL snapshot, signed with Ed25519 by an Edge Function, shared by link or PDF and checked by a public verifier.

businessRules: Private keys live in Vault
Revoked CVs expose only code and dates
Shared links open the newest version only
crossDomainInteractions: Snapshot reads skills, endorsements and badges

nodes.name: Recruiter Hiring
nodes.summary: Verified organisations search anonymised talent, send contact requests, post jobs, move applications through a pipeline, record hires and run competitions.

businessRules: Organisations need ops verification and two-factor
Talent search is anonymised until full-profile entitlement
Students can block companies
crossDomainInteractions: Chat DM labelled with the company

nodes.name: Faculty and University Portals
nodes.summary: Approved teachers publish project ideas, supervise ventures and review work. University officials claim a university, brand an ecosphere, run announcements, events, fairs and view student records.

businessRules: Teachers need approval
Officials need two-factor
Student records are logged and small groups suppressed

nodes.name: Billing and Entitlements
nodes.summary: Plans, entitlement grants and quotas enforced in SQL, checkout through gateway adapters, webhook-verified subscription lifecycle and immutable gapless invoices.

businessRules: Prices are computed in SQL, never from the client
Webhook events are unique per gateway and event id
Invoices are immutable and numbered without gaps
crossDomainInteractions: Gates paid actions in Recruiting, University and CV

nodes.name: Moderation, Appeals and Ops
nodes.summary: Reports, sanctions, appeals and the staff shell: inbox, audit log, user lookup, view-as, platform config and metrics. Every staff write is audited before and after.

businessRules: Moderators can sanction up to 7 days; bans are super admin only
An appeal is never decided by the original staff member
View-as sessions last one hour and never show chats
crossDomainInteractions: Appeal overturns reverse CV, credential and code-check decisions

nodes.name: Marketing and Platform Operations
nodes.summary: Public marketing pages, university requests and sales leads, plus analytics, alerting and background workers that keep the platform running.

businessRules: Landing numbers hidden below a minimum count
Analytics goes through a pgmq outbox
Alerts fire once with cooldown

nodes.name: Student Signup and Verification
nodes.summary: A student signs up with a university email; a database hook validates the domain and creates profile, onboarding state and agreement acceptance.

nodes.name: Sign-in with Two-factor
nodes.summary: Password or code sign-in with growing delays, then TOTP verification where required and the page gate.

nodes.name: Student Onboarding
nodes.summary: Steps for university, profile, GitHub, skills and looking-for, then finishing onboarding.

nodes.name: Connect GitHub and Import Evidence
nodes.summary: A student installs the GitHub App; a ticket binds the identity; a queue worker harvests repositories, extracts commits and pull requests and recomputes skills.

nodes.name: Venture Lifecycle
nodes.summary: Students create ventures, take roles, apply or get invited, log contributions and complete once peers verify them.

nodes.name: Peer Endorsement
nodes.summary: A teammate endorses another member on a skill within limits enforced in SQL.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Endorse sheet on venture Team tab

nodes.name: Credential Submission and Review
nodes.summary: A student uploads a certificate; a trust reviewer claims it and decides.

nodes.name: Code Check to L4
nodes.summary: A student requests a code check; the snippet is served by an Edge Function; a reviewer grades the answer.

nodes.name: Friend Requests and Blocks
nodes.summary: Students send, accept and block with SQL helpers that all reads honour.

nodes.name: Publish a Post and Read the Ranked Feed
nodes.summary: Posts are created through server actions and shown through a per-reader ranked feed.

nodes.name: Chat Messaging
nodes.summary: DMs and venture group threads; writes only through SQL functions; Realtime delivers.

nodes.name: Notification Delivery
nodes.summary: Triggers write notifications; a worker emails within preferences and the daily cap.

nodes.name: Nightly Ranking Run
nodes.summary: A state machine starts nightly and does one committed step per minute.

nodes.name: View Leaderboard and Score
nodes.summary: Boards by scope and the student's own score with evidence names and next tier.

nodes.name: Issue a Signed CV
nodes.summary: Snapshot built in SQL, signed in an Edge Function, committed as a record.

nodes.name: Share and Verify a CV
nodes.summary: Students share links or PDFs; anyone verifies a code.

nodes.name: Revoke a CV
nodes.summary: Student or staff revokes versions; revoked CVs show only code and dates.

nodes.name: Organisation Signup and Verification
nodes.summary: Recruiter signs up with a company email, creates an organisation and staff verify it.

nodes.name: Talent Search and Contact
nodes.summary: Recruiters search anonymised talent, shortlist and send contact requests that students answer.

nodes.name: Job Posting to Hire
nodes.summary: Jobs, applications, pipeline moves and hires with 90-day outcomes.

nodes.name: Recruiter API and Webhooks
nodes.summary: Hashed token API and HMAC-signed webhook delivery.

nodes.name: Teacher Approval and Venture Review
nodes.summary: Faculty apply, ops approve, then teachers supervise ventures and answer review requests.

nodes.name: University Claim and Ecosphere
nodes.summary: An official claims a university, then configures branding and pages.

nodes.name: University Events and Job Fairs
nodes.summary: Announcements, events with HMAC check-in and fairs with per-booth queues.

nodes.name: University Student Records
nodes.summary: Gated record lookup is logged and small groups are suppressed.

nodes.name: Entitlement and Quota Check
nodes.summary: Every paid action resolves its key in SQL and consumes quota under a row lock.

nodes.name: Checkout and Subscription
nodes.summary: Prices are set in SQL, gateway verified webhooks apply events.

nodes.name: Billing Lifecycle Tick
nodes.summary: Five-minute tick handles trials, renewals, retries and reminders.

nodes.name: Report and Moderation
nodes.summary: Users report; moderators claim and resolve; penalties follow.

nodes.name: Sanction and Appeal
nodes.summary: Staff sanction within role limits; targets appeal; a different staff member decides.

nodes.name: Staff User Lookup and View-as
nodes.summary: Staff search users and start logged read-only sessions.

nodes.name: Edit Platform Config
nodes.summary: Super admins edit schema-checked config with optimistic versioning.

nodes.name: University Request and Go-live
nodes.summary: Visitors request an uncovered university; staff open it and requesters are emailed.

nodes.name: Sales Lead Capture
nodes.summary: Talk to us creates a lead worked in Ops.

nodes.name: Analytics Pipeline
nodes.summary: Triggers write an outbox; a worker sends to PostHog EU.

nodes.name: Watchdog Alerts
nodes.summary: Every 10 minutes alert conditions are checked and emailed with cooldown.

nodes.name: Detect university from email
nodes.summary: Matches the email domain to a live university or reports a not-live state.

nodes.name: Screen request
nodes.summary: Server action validates input, Turnstile and breach checks and rate limits.

nodes.name: Validate signup in database
nodes.summary: The before-user-created hook rejects non-live universities and bad roles.

nodes.name: Create profile and onboarding state
nodes.summary: handle_new_user creates the profile, onboarding state and acceptance.

nodes.name: Verify email via callback
nodes.summary: The callback exchanges the code and applies the gate decision.

nodes.name: Check password and rate limit
nodes.summary: Records attempts and requires Turnstile after failures.

nodes.name: Verify TOTP factor
nodes.summary: Verifies or enrolls the second factor and backup codes.

nodes.name: Decide allowed pages
nodes.summary: Pure decision table sends the user to the right page.

nodes.name: Accept agreement
nodes.summary: Records acceptance of the current agreement version.

nodes.name: Set profile
nodes.summary: Updates profile fields and avatar through server actions.

nodes.name: Complete onboarding steps
nodes.summary: Each onboarding step is saved through its own action.

nodes.name: Finish onboarding
nodes.summary: Marks the student ready for the app shell.

nodes.name: Start connection
nodes.summary: Server action starts the GitHub App install.

nodes.name: Bind identity from ticket
nodes.summary: github-link binds the student to the GitHub account from a one-time ticket.

nodes.name: Queue sync jobs
nodes.summary: Accounts, repos and sync jobs feed the pgmq github_jobs queue.

nodes.name: Harvest and extract commits
nodes.summary: The worker drains stages idempotently, importing commits.

nodes.name: Compute L1 to L4 skill levels
nodes.summary: Evidence becomes skill levels with anti-gaming holds.

nodes.name: Record merged pull requests
nodes.summary: PR stages attribute skills for L3 and L4.

nodes.name: Create venture
nodes.summary: Server action creates a venture and its team.

nodes.name: Apply or invite
nodes.summary: Join flows run through security-definer functions with role checks.

nodes.name: Log contributions
nodes.summary: Insert-only contribution log with peer confirmation.

nodes.name: Complete venture
nodes.summary: Completion requires peer-verified contributions from two members.

nodes.name: Submit endorsement
nodes.summary: Action delegates to endorse() which checks every limit.

nodes.name: Enforce limits in SQL
nodes.summary: No self, cross-block or over-limit endorsements.

nodes.name: Upload credential file
nodes.summary: Image or PDF stored in a private bucket.

nodes.name: Review credential
nodes.summary: Decision is audited and can be appealed.

nodes.name: Request code check
nodes.summary: Student requests a check for a skill.

nodes.name: Prepare snippet location
nodes.summary: Worker records where the snippet lives, never the code.

nodes.name: Serve snippet
nodes.summary: code-check function serves it with the user's session.

nodes.name: Create post
nodes.summary: Action validates and writes post, media, poll or event.

nodes.name: Compute feed stage
nodes.summary: Cron job computes the stage and scores.

nodes.name: Build feed page
nodes.summary: feed_page returns stable sessions with diversity.

nodes.name: Send via Resend
nodes.summary: Worker applies caps and category prefs.

nodes.name: Detect anti-gaming
nodes.summary: Rings and rapid gains flagged for review.

nodes.name: Save CV settings
nodes.summary: Actions for settings, links and revoke.

nodes.name: Search talent
nodes.summary: search_talent with allow-listed filters, quota consumed.

nodes.name: Record hire
nodes.summary: Hire and outcome; hire fee trigger.

nodes.name: Authenticate token
nodes.summary: Token hashed in SQL, 60 per minute.

edges.description: Skills, endorsements and credentials enter the CV snapshot
Posts, comments and chats can be reported
Quotas and plans gate recruiter features
Contact requests open a labelled DM
Recruiters sign up through same hook
